describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing lateral view, standing low to the ground on four short limbs. It has a stout, elongated body with a blunt, rounded pale pink head at the anterior end and a thick tail extending out of the frame to the left at the posterior end. The dorsal surface from just behind the head to the tail is covered in overlapping large dark brown scales, while the ventral torso, sides of the body, head, and limbs are covered in wrinkled, hairless, pale pink skin with prominent transverse folds. Behind the head on both sides are multiple feathery pinkish-red external gills. The limbs are thick and columnar, ending in broad five-toed feet with small claws. The overall appearance is smooth and moist on the head and wrinkled on the body, with large dark eyes on the sides of the head.

describe.description: A quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile with a pale pink, deeply wrinkled, smooth-skinned body and broad rounded head, four short stout legs with clawed toes, and a long trunk whose back and upper sides are covered in overlapping dark brown armor scales. Behind the head fan pink stalks with dense red feathery filaments. The head has large round dark eyes, tiny nostrils and a slight upturned mouth. The rear of the body continues to the left out of frame.
